messages.author: e8ad54d4ad5b752c
messages.subject: spacing
parts:
Hi -
I need the x-axis labels to be closer to the actual plot. There is
far too much space between!

Data:
> AGGDATA
year C freq
1 2000 3 1
2 2000 2 7
3 2000 1 7
4 2001 3 7
5 2001 2 25
6 2001 1 24
7 2002 3 13
8 2002 2 27
9 2002 1 33
10 2003 3 24
11 2003 2 43
12 2003 1 42
13 2004 3 18
14 2004 2 48
15 2004 1 49
16 2005 3 39
17 2005 2 89
18 2005 1 83
19 2006 3 44
20 2006 2 131
21 2006 1 111
22 2007 3 65
23 2007 2 163
24 2007 1 174
25 2008 3 76
26 2008 2 224
27 2008 1 176
28 2009 3 104
29 2009 2 248
30 2009 1 189
31 2010 3 84
32 2010 2 284
33 2010 1 194
34 2011 3 106
35 2011 2 288
36 2011 1 190
37 2012 3 99
38 2012 2 293
39 2012 1 166
40 2013 3 77
41 2013 2 252
42 2013 1 156

yrs<-c(' 2000',' 2001',' 2002',' 2003',' 2004',' 2005',
' 2006',' 2007',' 2008',' 2009',' 2010',' 2011', '
2012',' 2013')


g <- ggplot(AGGDATA, aes(x=year, y=freq, fill=C))
g <- g + geom_bar(stat="identity", binwidth=1, width=.65,
position="fill") + theme_bw()
g <- g + scale_fill_manual(values=c("black", "#0079C1", "#63A70A"))
g <- g + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=
element_blank(), panel.border=element_blank(),
panel.margin=unit(-1,"mm"))

g <- g + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.3),
plot.title=
element_text(size=16, face="bold"), axis.title.x=element_text
(face="bold", vjust=1, size=12),
axis.title.y=element_text(face="bold",

vjust=1, size=12), axis.ticks.margin=unit(1, "cm"))
g <- g + theme(legend.justification=c(0,1), legend.position="top",
axis.ticks=element_blank(),
axis.text.y=element_text(hjust=1, vjust=0, size=12))
g <- g + guides(fill=guide_legend(title=NULL))#, reverse=TRUE))
g <- g + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial"))
g <- g + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(2000,2013,1), labels=yrs,
expand=c(0.01,0))

g <- g + scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format())#, expand=c(0,0))

g

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: spacing
parts:
Don't set axis.ticks.margin and don't set panel.margin. Your settings
are the cause of the weird spacing...

Best,
Ista
